note: Countable anti-tank roster limits from the dynasty rules (docs/LEAGUE_RULES_MODEL.md, 'Roster / anti-tank governance'). scripts/season_state.py roster_checks() reports them per team as evidence for commissioner review; it never decides tanking intent (CLAUDE.md human-decision boundary).

longTermInjured.softNote: Yahoo statuses that mean a player may play. A player in an IL slot with one of these is being held there, not out; an IL player with no status is treated as injured (Yahoo IL rule). Any other code Yahoo invents (SUSP, NA, a new one) is neither out nor soft: shown as-is, never counted as out.
longTermInjured.note: Rule: max 5 long-term-injured players (IL, or GTD with a >2-week-out signal). Counted here: players in an IL / IL+ slot plus players Yahoo lists as Out (O / OUT), injured (INJ) or out for the season (OFS) while not on IL. Yahoo gives no injury duration, so a short absence can be counted; the commissioner judges.

minPerPositionNote: Rule: minimum 2 tagged players per position (3 for some two-position combos -- not automated). Counted over healthy players (not injured as above), from Yahoo position eligibility.

singlePosition.note: Rule: max 5 single-position-only players roster-wide (max 4 in the active roster); combo-position tags raise the cap to 7. 6-7 is shown for review because whether the combo exception applies is a judgment.

lineupSlotsNote: Active lineup slots as observed on the league's Yahoo team pages (2026-10-19). 'lineup' checks that the healthy roster can fill every slot on a full game day.
positionalLimitsNote: League owner, 2026-10-19: in most cases IL players do not count toward the positional limits because they cannot contribute. Single-position, coverage and lineup checks count healthy players only (not injured as defined above); the commissioner judges exceptions.
combosNote: Rule: min 3 tagged players for a two-position combo ('needing a 3rd SF/PF-tagged player if only 2 exist'). Counted: healthy players who can play either position of the combo; each combo feeds three lineup slots (PG, SG, G / SF, PF, F).
